<?php
$MOD = 998244353;
$MODF = floatval($MOD);
$SHRT = floatval(1 << 16);
$G = 3.0;
$MAXSIZ = 1 << 20;

function fmod_custom($x, $MODF) {
    return $x - $MODF * floatval(intval($x / $MODF));
}

function mod_prod($a, $b, $MODF, $SHRT) {
    $t = intval($a / $SHRT);
    $res = $t * fmod_custom($b * $SHRT, $MODF) + ($a - $SHRT * $t) * $b;
    return fmod_custom($res, $MODF);
}

function fpow($a, $b, $MODF, $SHRT) {
    $r = 1.0;
    while ($b) {
        if ($b & 1) $r = mod_prod($r, $a, $MODF, $SHRT);
        if ($b > 1) $a = mod_prod($a, $a, $MODF, $SHRT);
        $b >>= 1;
    }
    return $r;
}

list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$f = array_fill(0, $MAXSIZ, 0.0);
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
if ($line !== '') {
    foreach (explode(' ', $line) as $d) {
        $d = intval($d);
        $f[$d] = 1.0;
    }
}

$m = $MAXSIZ;
$m2 = intdiv($m, 2);
$w = array_fill(0, $m2, 1.0);
$w[1] = fpow($G, intdiv($MOD - 1, $m), $MODF, $SHRT);
for ($i = 2; $i < $m2; $i++) {
    $w[$i] = mod_prod($w[$i - 1], $w[1], $MODF, $SHRT);
}

$rev = array_fill(0, $m, 0);
for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $rev[$i] = $rev[$i >> 1] >> 1;
    if ($i & 1) $rev[$i] |= $m2;
}

function ntt_transform(&$a, $m, $rev, $w, $MODF, $SHRT) {
    for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
        if ($i < $rev[$i]) {
            $tmp = $a[$i];
            $a[$i] = $a[$rev[$i]];
            $a[$rev[$i]] = $tmp;
        }
    }
    $l = 2;
    while ($l <= $m) {
        $half = $l >> 1;
        $diff = intdiv($m, $l);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i += $l) {
            $pw = 0;
            for ($j = $i; $j < $i + $half; $j++) {
                $v = mod_prod($a[$j + $half], $w[$pw], $MODF, $SHRT);
                $a[$j + $half] = $a[$j] - $v;
                $a[$j] = $a[$j] + $v;
                $pw += $diff;
            }
        }
        $l <<= 1;
    }
}

ntt_transform($f, $m, $rev, $w, $MODF, $SHRT);
for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $f[$i] = fpow($f[$i], $n >> 1, $MODF, $SHRT);
}
ntt_transform($f, $m, $rev, $w, $MODF, $SHRT);

$inv_m = fpow(floatval($m), $MOD - 2, $MODF, $SHRT);
$sum = 0.0;
for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $sum += mod_prod($f[$i], $f[$i], $MODF, $SHRT);
}

$ans = mod_prod($sum, mod_prod($inv_m, $inv_m, $MODF, $SHRT), $MODF, $SHRT);
echo intval($ans) . PHP_EOL;

source_data.prob_desc_description: All bus tickets in Berland have their numbers. A number consists of $$$n$$$ digits ($$$n$$$ is even). Only $$$k$$$ decimal digits $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ can be used to form ticket numbers. If $$$0$$$ is among these digits, then numbers may have leading zeroes. For example, if $$$n = 4$$$ and only digits $$$0$$$ and $$$4$$$ can be used, then $$$0000$$$, $$$4004$$$, $$$4440$$$ are valid ticket numbers, and $$$0002$$$, $$$00$$$, $$$44443$$$ are not.A ticket is lucky if the sum of first $$$n / 2$$$ digits is equal to the sum of remaining $$$n / 2$$$ digits. Calculate the number of different lucky tickets in Berland. Since the answer may be big, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print the number of lucky ticket numbers, taken modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le k \le 10)$$$ — the number of digits in each ticket number, and the number of different decimal digits that may be used. $$$n$$$ is even. The second line contains a sequence of pairwise distinct integers $$$d_1, d_2, \dots, d_k$$$ $$$(0 \le d_i \le 9)$$$ — the digits that may be used in ticket numbers. The digits are given in arbitrary order.
